profiles.name: Armizan Mohd Ali
profiles.position: Minister of Domestic Trade and Cost of Living
profiles.description: Armizan Mohd Ali is Minister of Domestic Trade and Cost of Living. He represents Papar, Sabah, in the Dewan Rakyat. He is affiliated with Gabungan Rakyat Sabah (GRS).
profiles.affiliation_note: GRS coalition affiliation is verified. No constituent-party membership is inferred.

profiles.name: Gobind Singh Deo
profiles.description: Gobind Singh Deo is Minister of Digital. He represents Damansara, Selangor, in the Dewan Rakyat. He is a member of DAP.

milestones.title: Organise 30,000 Rahmah MADANI sales sessions in 2026
milestones.description: Armizan stated the revised annual target of 30,000 Rahmah MADANI sales sessions for 2026, increased from 23,040.
milestones.progress_note: His parliamentary update reports 15,881 sessions from 1 January to 30 June 2026. The bar is 15,881 ÷ 30,000 × 100 = 52.94%, rounded to 53%. It is the dated half-year delivery count, not a live November result or a measure of household savings.

milestones.title: Grow the digital economy’s contribution to 30% of GDP by 2030
milestones.description: Gobind reaffirmed a 30% digital-economy contribution to GDP by 2030 and linked delivery to the national AI and MD2030 plans.
milestones.progress_note: The minister described launched policies and implementation responsibilities. He cited a provisional 25.5% GDP share for 2025 while seeking confirmation of the exact figure. A sector share is not promise completion, so no numerical completion is inferred.

methodology: Editorial records of attributable commitments and dated evidence, not endorsements or independently audited performance scores. Promise dates use explicitly stated event dates where available. Year/month-only target dates use end-of-period markers, not an invented exact-day promise. Sector ratios, budget allocations and announcements are not completion scores.
